o: New wonders and new threats have been unlocked on CYBERWORLD. Energon Surge is taking over, but will it be a source of danger or immense power to those who learn to harness it? v.n: Meet Soundwave, the Kraken! Character Reveal #cyberworld…

eps.o: The games are bigger, the challenges are tougher and mysterious NEW POWERS are waiting to be unlocked. With old friends returning, dangerous new enemies emerging and surprising alliances forming, the battle for Cyberworld is about to reach a whole new level.

Elita-1 and Wheeljack are ambushed by a terrifying new version of Soundwave! Feral, super-powered and almost unrecognisable, SEA MONSTER Soundwave has been transformed by a mysterious energy, and Elita-1 is caught in his clutches. Meanwhile, Bumblebee continues his mission alone... but not for long.

Bumblebee is going underground for his toughest challenge yet: 100 LEVELS of traps! Joined by Mirage and Chop Shop, Bumblebee ventures deep beneath Cyberworld in search of mysterious new powers. But the further they descend, the more dangerous the traps become. How far can Bumblebee make it?

Jazz VS Soundwave in a music-powered RHYTHM BATTLE! Timing is everything as the two rivals battle to the beat in an action-packed rhythm challenge. But as Jazz reveals the story of his past with Soundwave, Elita-1 discovers a worrying connection to what's happening to Bumblebee...
